scope: Baseline for WT1.4: ten-profile debug build + xmake test, release build sizes, release boot.
claims: all ten debug kernels pass xmake test
all ten release kernels build and boot to status=ready

sources.relation: blob-identical to the commit (every tracked file)
blob-identical to the commit (every tracked file)

environment.xmake: xmake v3.1.1+HEAD.3ba37a0, A cross-platform build utility based on Lua
environment.systoolchain: SysToolchain 0.1.0 release archives (one per triple), installed with --systoolchain_dir

commands.label: kernel debug i386
commands.command: cd <tree> && xmake f -c -y -m debug -a i386 --systoolchain_dir=<systoolchain>/i386-elf --qemu_binary=<systoolchain>/i386-elf/bin/qemu-system-i386 && xmake -y -j 6 -b okernel_image && xmake test
